name: rtdb-modular-sync-write-and-disconnect-validation
description: Modular RTDB synchronous write, priority, and OnDisconnect validation: observes synchronous Error throws (vs async rejections), scrubbed SDK error messages, push(ref, undefined) key-only overload vs push(ref, invalid) throw, and unchanged stored RTDB data across set, update, push, setPriority, setWithPriority, and onDisconnect.

cases.label: set-undefined
cases.message: set failed: value argument contains undefined in property 'validation.node'

cases.label: set-nan-child
cases.message: set failed: value argument contains NaN in property 'validation.node.a'

cases.label: set-positive-infinity
cases.message: set failed: value argument contains Infinity in property 'validation.node.a'

cases.label: set-negative-infinity
cases.message: set failed: value argument contains -Infinity in property 'validation.node.a'

cases.label: set-function
cases.message: set failed: value argument contains a function in property 'validation.node' with contents = () => 1
